texts.orig: CONGRUENCES AND DENSITY RESULTS FOR PARTITIONS INTO DISTINCT EVEN PARTS
texts.text: CONGRUENCES AND DENSITY RESULTS FOR PARTITIONS INTO DISTINCT EVEN PARTS

texts.label: text
texts.orig: ABSTRACT . In this paper, we consider the set of partitions ped(n) which counts the number of partitions of n wherein the even parts are distinct and the odd parts are unrestricted)   Using an algorithm developed by Radu; we prove congruences modulo 192 which were conjectured by Nath [Nat24]. Further, we prove few infinite families of congruences modulo 24 by using a result  of Newman. Also; we prove that ped(9n + 7) is lacunary modulo 2k+2 3 and 3k+1 for all positive integers k 2 0 We further prove an infinite family of congruences for ped(n modulo arbitrary powers of 2 by employing a result of Ono and Taguchi on the nilpotency of Hecke operators.
